text: The Bangladesh Sustainable Recovery, Emergency Preparedness and Response Project (B-STRONG) is a comprehensive initiative aimed at enhancing flood resilience and recovery in Bangladesh. It focuses on flood protection infrastructure, agricultural restoration, and economic inclusion to mitigate the impacts of riverine and pluvial flooding exacerbated by climate change. The project is financed by the International Development Association of the World Bank Group and involves multiple public agencies in Bangladesh.
